profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced results-driven data/back-end engineer with strong skills to develop scalable distributed systems for batch and real time data.

Languages/Frameworks
 - Scala
 - Python
 - Java / Spring
 - SQL
Frameworks/Other
 - Spark (Spark and Spark Structured Streaming)
 - Pandas / Polars / Arrow
 - Akka streams
 - Iceberg / Delta Lake / Hudi
 - Metastore catalog management
 - MySQL / Postgres / Cassandra / HANA / Redis / BigQuery / Databricks
 - Kafka / Pulsar / Pubsub
 - Kubernetes
 - CI/CD
Cloud
 - Azure/GCP/AWS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing organization data platform for modern data warehousing models to supply clean live data for org wide initiatives utilizing data mesh concepts. Platform ingests numerous and variable sources of data ranging from batch loads to live application and IOT data.

Languages:
- Scala (3.x.x)
- Python

Frameworks:
- Spark (Structured streaming/batch)
- Custom Scala dataframe implementation

Systems:
- BigQuery
- Composer (airflow)
- GCP Pub/Sub
- Kafka
- Kubernetes (GKE)
- SparkOperator
- BigTable

Cloud:
- GCP

CICD:
- Cloud Build
- Gitlab
positions.insights: Software Project Management, Scala and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work on migrating legacy application and data management to more modern data platform. 

Accomplishments:

Efforts to stabilize legacy system accomplished with migration to Postgres from Cassandra with a savings over $1 million dollars per year. Reduced production incidents to near zero and downtime from hours to minutes


Languages:
- Scala

Frameworks:
- Spark
- Akka

Systems:
- Cassandra
- Postgres

Cloud:
- Azure

CICD:
- Gitlab
positions.insights: Software Project Management, Scala and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer - Motorsports Data
positions.description:
Develop system to take live vehicle racing data and stream to UI for racing teams to consumer/make race decisions

Accomplishments:

Develops a plug and play system to build complex Akka stream graphs from YAML file to boost ability to consumer from and produce data to destinations

Languages:
- Java

Frameworks:
- Akka (Akka Streams and Akka)

Systems:
- Postgres
- Kubernetes

Cloud:
- Azure
positions.insights: Kubernetes, Superior Communications Skills and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer - Data
positions.description:
Vehicle messaging platform to supply live vehicle data to internal and external consumers

Accomplishments:

Reduced system downtime due to caching interaction issues from daily/hour to non-existent

Languages
- Java

Frameworks:
- Spark (Streaming)
- Spring

Systems:
- redis
- Hive
- Cassandra
- Kafka/Pulsar
positions.insights: Superior Communications Skills, Data Streaming and +1 skill

positions.title: Data Analyst 4
positions.description:
Develop reporting migration from Excel to SAP HANA/Webi/Tableau

Accomplishments:

Company MVP given due to cost savings with automatic scheduled reporting production.
positions.insights: Superior Communications Skills and Data Modeling

honors.title: 2019 Company MVP
honors.description: Given the company MVP award for 2019 due to all the progress and enhancements created for the company. Was recommend by senior leadership for award
